newsitem.title: JAPAN: Keidanren says 110-120 yen/$ rate right for Toyota.
newsitem.headline: Keidanren says 110-120 yen/$ rate right for Toyota.

text.p: Shoichiro Toyoda, chairman of the influential business lobby Keidanren and chairman of Toyota Motor Corp, told a news conference on Tuesday that an exchange of rate of 110 to 120 yen per dollar was appropriate for Toyota Motor's operations.
"The exchange rate range of 110 to 120 yen (per dollar) reflects what is appropriate for our company," he said.
Toyoda said on Monday that the 110 to 120 yen per dollar rate reflects Japan's fundamentals.
He also reiterated his concern about extreme fluctuations in foreign exchange rates, as they result in undesirable changes in manufacturing costs.
